svg.title: Front view — drawers closed
svg.desc: Nine-drawer pedestal desk. Editable vector curves. Provisional 1400 by 750 by 780 mm. Hidden construction is inferred.
svg.metadata: {"version":"0.1","config":{"width":1400,"depth":750,"height":780,"scale":1,"quality":"high"},"view":"front","open":0,"explode":0,"assumptions":["All dimensions are provisional, not measurements.","Carving outlines and relief depths are photo interpretations.","Rear construction, drawer joinery, runners, and four rear feet are inferred.","Timber species, top covering, age, and origin are unverified."]}

g.text: P-L: left pedestal · P-R: right pedestal · T-TOP: tabletop · H 780 mm
Confirmed: nine drawers and visible front features. Inferred: rear feet, backs, drawer internals.
All sizes provisional; carving depths interpreted; timber and top covering unverified.
